literal: Giving, compassion, just rule, subjects protecting, all four he who possesses is to kings a light.
translation: He who possesses all four traits—charity, compassion, a just rule, and the protection of his subjects—is a guiding light among kings.
modern: கொடை, கருணை, நீதி தவறாத ஆட்சி, மக்களைப் பாதுகாத்தல் ஆகிய நான்கையும் உடையவன் அரசர்களுக்குள் ஒளி போன்றவன் ஆவான்.
explanation: This couplet defines the four essential qualities of a great ruler. The word 'கொடை' means generosity in giving, while 'அளி' refers to a compassionate disposition towards others. 'செங்கோல்' literally means a straight scepter, symbolizing an unbiased and just administration, and 'குடி ஓம்பல்' is the active protection and care of the citizens. A ruler who embodies all these four traits stands out brilliantly, serving as a guiding light for all other kings to follow.
